title: Classes and Objects
description: Learn to define classes and create objects.

data.text: A **class** is a blueprint for creating objects. An **object** is an instance of a class with its own state and behavior.

data.title: Class and Object
Key Takeaways
points: Class is a blueprint, object is an instance
Multiple objects can be created from one class
data.takeaway: Classes define structure, objects bring them to life.
